title: Savings Membership Eligibility and Household Composition
content:
# Eligibility and Household Composition — Dental and Vision Savings Memberships

A Dental and Vision Savings Membership is purchased by a primary member. The entry requirements, the persons a membership may cover and the states where it is sold are set per membership as follows.

## Entry and coverage limits

| Membership | Minimum age of the primary member | Household membership | Persons the membership may cover | Household definition | Dependent age limit |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cascade Smile Savings Individual | 18 years | No | 1 | Not applicable | 26 |
| Cascade Smile Savings Household | 18 years | Yes | 8 | Spouse or partner and children | 26 |
| Cascade Smile & Sight Savings Individual | 18 years | No | 1 | Not applicable | 26 |
| Cascade Smile & Sight Savings Household | 18 years | Yes | 8 | Spouse or partner and children | 26 |
| Cascade Smile & Sight Savings Plus Individual | 18 years | No | 1 | Not applicable | 26 |
| Cascade Smile & Sight Savings Plus Household | 18 years | Yes | 8 | Spouse or partner and children | 26 |

**Household definition "spouse or partner and children":** the primary member, a spouse or domestic partner and children under the dependent age limit living in the household. The dependent age limit is an age in years: household children are covered before this birthday, so with a limit of 26 a child is covered up to the day before the 26th birthday.

## States and disclosure (all six memberships)

| Item | Setting |
|---|---|
| States where the membership is sold (discount plan organization registrations) | WA, OR, CA, AZ, NV, ID, UT, CO, TX |
| Not-insurance disclosure | Required: every enrollment discloses that the membership is not insurance |

## Illustrative cases (hypothetical persons)

- A household of a primary member, a spouse and three children aged 4, 12 and 25 living in the household is five persons, within the 8 a household membership may cover; the 25-year-old is before the 26th birthday.
- A child who has reached the 26th birthday is outside the household definition.
- An Individual membership covers 1 person: the primary member.
